policy.mapping: Each target PNG is byte-identical to exactly one file in the pinned upstream IconMonsterHead732 directory, proven by Git blob SHA.
policy.separation: Portraits are a separate asset role from the existing echo.icon library and do not replace or stretch those icons.
policy.extras: Upstream portrait files not mapped to a canonical released Bellibing Echo remain excluded.
policy.deferred: Full-art reveal, parallax/living-still motion and functional Echo UI wiring are outside this asset slice.
